name: Push notification by Pushmarket.io
author: Aditya panther

sections.description:
PushMarket.io offers a comprehensive suite of WordPress plugins designed to help website owners easily integrate and manage web push notifications. These plugins provide a seamless way to reach out to your visitors with timely updates, promotions, or important information directly within their browsers.

Key features of PushMarket.io’s WordPress plugins include:

  1. Efficient Notification Delivery: Send targeted push notifications that increase engagement and reduce bounce rates.
  2. User Segmentation: Segment your audience based on various criteria such as demographics, behavior, and more to send personalized messages.
  3. Customizable Notification Templates: Choose from pre-designed templates or create custom designs to match the look and feel of your website.
  4. Automation Tools: Automate notifications for events like new blog posts, product launches, and special offers.
  5. Analytics and Reporting: Track notification performance, engagement rates, and user feedback to optimize strategies.
  6. Compliance and Security: Ensure that your push notifications comply with privacy regulations and are secure.
  7. With PushMarket.io’s WordPress plugins, you can enhance user experience, drive traffic, and foster customer loyalty through effective web push notifications.

External services

We connect to external APIs to make it work.

  1. We use these APIs to insert dynamic content from the SDK, which loads the notification dialog and asks notification permission from users on the website. (https://pushmarket.io/sdk/pushmarket-io.js?projectId=)
  2. We use these APIs to send notifications to users whenever an article or blog is posted. (http://api.pushmarket.io/send-notification)
  3. We use these APIs to track notification impressions & clicks of the user. (https://api.pushmarket.io/statistics/{notificationId}/tracker?actionType={type})

This service is provided by “pushmarket.io”: privacy policy, Terms & Conditions

Key Features

We have listed our key features below:

Features:

  1. Real-time Push Notifications
  2. Schedule Notifications
  3. Notification History
  4. Subscriber Management
  5. Subscriber Country and Regions
  6. Notification Impression and Click Count
  7. Notification CTR (Click Through Rate)

How to Configure after Installation

  1. Create an account on https://pushmarket.io
  2. Create a project with your website name, icon, and description.
  3. Go to the settings of that project.
  4. Generate an API key.
  5. Go to the WordPress Settings submenu and look for pushmarket.io.
  6. Copy the project ID and secret from the PushMarket project settings.
  7. Paste them in the WordPress PushMarket.io settings.
  8. Now you have configured the WordPress PushMarket.io plugin correctly. You can use it now.

documentation :- docs.pushmarket.io

sections.faq:
is it free to use ?

Yes, it’s free to use but has some limits with the free version of pushmarket.io.

why should I use it ?

You should use it to send real-time marketing campaigns and increase engagement with your website visitors.
